note: Illustrative weights for a planning aid, not a policy model. World cards move the warming meter by their approximate share of global greenhouse-gas emissions (EDGAR, rounded). 'Here' cards change what the climate does to Apetit's land and costs; they barely move the meter.

policies.title: China delivers net zero by 2060
policies.summary: Largest emitter, about 30 % of global emissions. Delivering its pledge is the single biggest lever on the warming Apetit's growers will face.
policies.source: EDGAR global GHG emissions; China's 2060 carbon-neutrality pledge

policies.title: United States returns to net zero by 2050
policies.summary: About 11 % of global emissions. Federal climate policy has been rolled back, so this card is speculative.

policies.title: India delivers net zero by 2070
policies.summary: About 8 % of global emissions and rising fastest of the large economies.
policies.source: EDGAR global GHG emissions; India's 2070 net-zero pledge

policies.title: EU delivers climate neutrality by 2050
policies.summary: About 6 % of global emissions. Legally binding under the European Climate Law; the 2040 target is being set.

policies.title: Rest of the world meets its net-zero pledges
policies.summary: Everyone else, about 45 % of emissions. Without them no single bloc can hold warming down.
policies.source: EDGAR global GHG emissions; Climate Action Tracker

policies.title: Finland: carbon neutral by 2035
policies.summary: Finland emits about 0.1 % of the world total. Watch the meter: it barely moves. Local policy changes what the climate does to the land, not the climate itself.

policies.title: Nature Restoration Law: restore drained farmland peat
policies.summary: Restore 30 % of drained organic soils under agriculture by 2030, 40 % by 2040, 50 % by 2050 (national target; applied here proportionally to contract peat as a simplification).

policies.title: No annual crops on drained peat from 2030
policies.summary: A stricter national rule. Removes peat emissions under Apetit crops but takes that area out of production.
policies.source: Scenario; organic-soil factors from package METHODOLOGY.md §5

policies.title: Catch crops required after early harvest
policies.summary: Extends Finland's CAP winter-cover eco-scheme into a requirement after pea and spinach. Cuts nitrogen leaching; cost per the lever catalogue.
policies.source: Finland CAP Strategic Plan 2023–2027 (eco-schemes); package lever L10

policies.title: EU ETS2: carbon price on fuels from 2028
policies.summary: Puts a carbon price on farm and transport diesel. Price path follows the world scenario.

policies.title: CBAM on imported fertiliser
policies.summary: Imported nitrogen fertiliser pays the EU carbon price on its production emissions, levelling with EU-made fertiliser. Raises growers' input costs as the carbon price rises.
policies.source: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 (CBAM); AN footprint 3.7 kg CO₂e/kg N from package METHODOLOGY.md §5
